common.ai_unavailable: The AI service is busy right now. Please try again in a moment.

disclaimer.short: AI-generated information to help you understand your records. Not a diagnosis or medical advice. Always consult your doctor. Emergency: call 112.

onboarding.title: Create your health profile
onboarding.subtitle: Your records stay on this device's server. You can link ABHA later.
onboarding.name: Full name
onboarding.why_gender: Used to pick the right reference ranges for lab results.
onboarding.for_you: Hi {{name}}! A few details about you help explain your results correctly.

dashboard.subtitle: Here is your health at a glance.
dashboard.abnormal_empty: No out-of-range results in your latest tests.
dashboard.summary_loading: Reading your records and writing a simple summary…
dashboard.review_pending: {{count}} documents are waiting for your review
dashboard.empty_body: Upload a prescription, lab report or discharge summary, or import records using your ABHA.
dashboard.critical_note: One or more results are in a critical range. Please contact your doctor today or seek urgent care.
dashboard.review_pending_one: 1 document is waiting for your review

upload.title: Upload medical records
upload.subtitle: Prescriptions, lab reports, discharge summaries or scan reports — printed or handwritten, in English or Indian languages.
upload.formats: PDF, JPG, PNG or WEBP · up to 25 MB each
upload.tip1: Photograph in good light, flat, with the whole page visible.
upload.tip2: Upload every page of multi-page reports (a PDF is best).
upload.tip3: You will review and confirm everything before it is saved.

reject.file-invalid-type: use PDF, JPG, PNG or WEBP

upload.delete_confirm: Delete this upload? Nothing from it has been saved to your records yet.

review.title: Review extracted information
review.subtitle: Check the values against your document. Items marked for review need a closer look.
review.name: Name
review.dirty: You changed some values. Recheck to update codes and flags.

docview.delete_confirm: Delete this document and its data?
docview.fhir_explainer: This is the form in which the record is shared through ABDM: an HL7 FHIR R4 document bundle using the NRCeS profiles. Standard codes (LOINC for tests, SNOMED CT for record types, ICD-10 for diagnoses) let any hospital or lab system read it.

timeline.title: Health timeline
timeline.subtitle: Every record in one place, newest first.

trends.title: Test trends
trends.subtitle: See how your results change over time. The shaded band is the reference range.
trends.empty: Trends appear once you have test results.

chat.title: Ask your health copilot
chat.subtitle: Answers come from your own records, with sources.
chat.placeholder: Ask about your reports, medicines or results…
chat.not_in_records: Not found in your records — general information
chat.doctor_hint: This is best discussed with your doctor.
chat.s1: What do my latest test results mean?
chat.s2: Which medicines am I taking and when?
chat.s3: How has my HbA1c changed over time?
chat.s4: What should I ask my doctor at my next visit?
chat.greeting: Hi {{name}}, what would you like to know?
chat.from_records: From your records · values and flags checked by code
chat.enter_hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
chat.audio_mode_hint: Read every reply aloud, and send spoken questions straight away
chat.voice_error: Voice is unavailable right now. Please try again.
chat.mic_denied: Microphone access is blocked. Allow it from the icon in the browser's address bar.
chat.mic_insecure: Voice input works when the app is opened at localhost or over https.
chat.mic_unsupported: This browser does not support voice input.
chat.no_speech: I didn't catch that. Please try again.

abha.title: ABHA & health records
abha.subtitle: Link your Ayushman Bharat Health Account to import records from hospitals and labs (ABDM). This is a sandbox simulation.
abha.import_title: Import records from a health facility
abha.import_body: Give consent to fetch your records from City Care Hospital (mock HIP) as FHIR bundles.
abha.export_body: Download all your confirmed records as an ABDM-style FHIR R4 bundle to share with any doctor or app.
abha.unlink_confirm: Unlink this ABHA from the profile? Imported records stay.

auth.welcome_sub: Sign in to see your health records.
auth.create_sub: Your records are private to your account.
auth.name: Your name
auth.private_note: Only you can see the records in your account.
auth.hero_title: All your health records, explained simply
auth.forgot_sub: Enter the email or mobile number you sign in with. We'll email a code to the account's verified email.
auth.forgot_no_email: Never added an email to your account? Then it can't be reset by email. If you're still signed in on another device, add an email under Your account.
auth.verify_sub: Enter the code we sent to finish creating your account.
auth.reset_sub: Enter the code from your email and choose a new password. Other devices will be signed out.
auth.email_hint: We send a code here to verify your account, and it's how you reset a forgotten password.
auth.name_invalid: Names can't contain numbers or symbols
auth.phone_hint: Add it to sign in with your mobile number or your email.
auth.sign_out_body: You'll need your email or mobile number and password to sign in again.

profile.add_sub: Keep a separate health record for a parent, child or spouse in your account.

contact.email_invalid: Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com
contact.phone_digits: Mobile numbers in {{country}} have {{want}} digits — you entered {{count}}
contact.phone_invalid: This doesn't look like a valid mobile number for {{country}}
contact.login_hint: Type a mobile number to pick its country, or start with + and the country code

profiles.title: Manage family
profiles.subtitle: Add, edit or remove the family members whose health records you keep.
profiles.edit_sub: Changes apply to this profile only.
profiles.delete_confirm: Remove {{name}}? All of their documents and health records will be deleted permanently.
profiles.relationship_required: Please choose how this person is related to you
profiles.relationship_other_required: Please type how this person is related to you
profiles.dob_invalid: Enter a date between 1900 and today
profiles.phone_hint: Optional. You can sign in with your email or this number.
profiles.change_password_sub: Other devices will be signed out.
profiles.password_changed: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.
profiles.delete_account_sub: Permanently delete your account, every profile and all uploaded documents.
profiles.you_sub: The account holder. You can edit your details here.
profiles.family_sub: Edit anyone's details or remove them. Removing a member also deletes their records.
profiles.family_empty: No family members yet. Add a parent, spouse or child to keep their records here too.
profiles.self_note: Your own profile stays while your account exists. To remove it, delete your account below.

code.label: 6-digit code
code.sent: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. It expires in {{minutes}} minutes.
code.sent_reset: If that account has a verified email, we've sent a 6-digit code to it. It expires in {{minutes}} minutes.
code.spam: Can't find it? Check your spam or promotions folder.
code.dev: Email isn't set up on this local server, so here is the code: {{code}}
code.invalid: Enter the 6 digits from the email
code.resend_in: Send a new code in {{count}} s

email.title: Email for codes and alerts
email.sub: Used to verify changes, reset a forgotten password and send the notifications you choose.
email.password_needed: Enter your current password to change your email
email.banner_title: Add an email to protect your account
email.banner_body: Without a verified email you can't reset a forgotten password, and you won't get security alerts or medicine reminders.

notify.title: Email notifications
notify.sub: Choose what we email you about.
notify.needs_email: Verify an email first to get these.
notify.security_sub: New sign-ins, and changes to your password or email
notify.medicines_sub: When a medicine course is about to end or has just ended
notify.weekly_sub: New records, results outside the usual range and active medicines

account.title: Your account
account.subtitle: Your sign-in details, email, password and notifications.

rem.title: Reminders
rem.subtitle: Medicines for everyone in the family, built from your prescriptions, plus visits and tests coming up.
rem.no_doses: No medicine reminders for this day.
rem.no_doses_body: Confirm a prescription and the copilot schedules the reminders, or add one yourself below.
rem.appointments_sub: Follow-ups found in your records or added by you, for the next two weeks and anything overdue.
rem.no_appointments: Nothing scheduled in the next two weeks.
rem.what_placeholder: e.g. Eye check-up with Dr. Rao
rem.schedules_sub: Change times, pause, or stop a reminder when a course ends.
rem.adherence: Last 7 days: {{percent}}% of doses marked taken ({{taken}} of {{scheduled}})
rem.stop_confirm: Stop this reminder? Do this only when the course has ended or your doctor told you to.
rem.delete_confirm: Delete this reminder? The copilot will not schedule it again for the same prescription.
rem.push_unsupported: This browser can't show reminder notifications. On iPhone, add the app to the Home Screen first.
rem.push_denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in the browser settings to get reminders.

care.title: Health insights
care.subtitle: Trends, risks and next steps worked out from {{name}}'s own records. Things to discuss with your doctor, never a diagnosis.
care.not_translated: Some text is shown in English because translation is unavailable right now.
care.empty_body: Add lab reports and prescriptions. Insights appear once there are results to compare.
care.risks_sub: Values that stay out of range, changes over time and combinations that doctors look at together.
care.no_risks: Nothing stands out in the latest records.
care.next_steps_sub: Repeat tests, follow-ups and screenings commonly advised for this age and these conditions.
care.no_next_steps: No repeat tests or screenings to suggest right now.
care.wellness_sub: General lifestyle tips picked for this person's results, conditions and age, with the reason for each.

copilot.just_did: Your copilot acted on this record
copilot.title: Copilot actions
copilot.subtitle: What your copilot did on its own and what it suggests. Keep it, change it or undo it: you stay in control.
copilot.feed_sub: Reminders it scheduled, follow-ups it found and tests it thinks are due.
copilot.empty_body: When you confirm a prescription or report, the copilot sets up reminders and follow-ups here.
copilot.questions_sub: Drafted from your latest results and trends. Edit them before you go.
copilot.no_questions: Questions appear after you add a prescription or report.
copilot.adherence_line: {{percent}}% of doses taken in the last 7 days
